faq.caption: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Clear answers to
faq.contactDescription: Sign in as a company or kitchen and manage corporate catering from one place.

items.question: Who is Lunch Drop for?
items.answer: The platform is built for companies, kitchens accepting corporate orders, and employees using the mobile app.

items.question: What can a company manage?
items.answer: A company adds branches and employees, connects kitchens, and monitors orders from one dashboard.

items.question: How does a kitchen process orders?
items.answer: The kitchen manages its menu, accepts orders, and updates their status step by step.

items.question: What does the mobile app provide employees?
items.answer: Employees browse menus, choose meals, order, and follow their order status and history.

items.question: Can every party see the order status?
items.answer: Yes. The company, kitchen, and employee all see the same current order status.

items.content: Lunch Drop organized our lunch workflow. Employees order easily and admins track status in one place.
The platform is simple and clear, with fewer steps for managing branches, kitchens, and employees.
Daily orders and statuses are immediately visible, so we always know the current state.
Approving employees and connecting branches and kitchens is now much faster.
Clear ordering and delivery times have made our work easier.
Managing lunch expenses and branch orders has become simpler.
Having orders, statuses, and notifications in one system works well for our team.
Each user sees the sections relevant to their role.
